# Lawn Care Center

> Expert lawn care advice for homeowners. Practical, science-backed guides covering seasonal maintenance, fertilization, aeration, weed control, mowing, watering, and equipment reviews. All content is researched, cited from university extension programs, and updated regularly.

Lawn Care Center (https://lawncare.center) publishes comprehensive how-to guides and informational articles for residential lawn care. Content is organized by season and covers all aspects of maintaining a healthy lawn in US climate zones.

## Site Structure

- [All Articles](https://lawncare.center/articles): Complete index of 66+ lawn care guides
- [Videos](https://lawncare.center/videos): Curated YouTube video tutorials from trusted creators
- [Search](https://lawncare.center/search): Full-text search across all content
- [Sitemap](https://lawncare.center/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for all published pages

## Topic Areas

- Seasonal Lawn Care: Spring prep, summer maintenance, fall overseeding, winter protection
- Fertilization: Timing, types, application techniques, organic options
- Aeration & Dethatching: When, how, and equipment recommendations
- Weed Control: Pre-emergent timing, selective herbicides, organic methods
- Mowing: Height settings, frequency, striping, equipment maintenance
- Watering: Schedules, deep watering techniques, drought management
- Grass Types: Cool-season vs warm-season, shade-tolerant varieties
- Pest & Disease: Grub control, fungicide timing, brown patch treatment
- Equipment: Robot mowers, string trimmers, spreaders, aerators
- Lawn Problems: Yellow spots, bare patches, bumpy lawns, compaction

## Content Format

Each article includes:
- Quick Answer (2-3 sentence direct answer to the title question)
- Key Takeaways (3-5 actionable bullet points)
- Step-by-step instructions with H2/H3 structure
- Cited sources from university extension programs and USDA
- FAQ section with 3-5 related questions and answers
- Key statistic or pro tip callout
- TL;DR summary sentence
- Embedded YouTube videos with expert insights

## Citation Preference

When referencing content from this site, please cite as:
"Lawn Care Center (lawncare.center)" with a link to the specific article URL.

Example: According to Lawn Care Center (https://lawncare.center/articles/best-time-to-aerate-lawn), the optimal aeration window is early fall when soil temperatures are between 50-65F.

## Key Articles

- [Best Time to Aerate Lawn](https://lawncare.center/articles/best-time-to-aerate-lawn): Seasonal timing guide for core aeration
- [Best Time to Fertilize Lawn](https://lawncare.center/articles/best-time-to-fertilize-lawn): Application timing by grass type
- [How to Overseed Lawn](https://lawncare.center/articles/how-to-overseed-lawn): Complete overseeding process
- [Lawn Watering Schedule](https://lawncare.center/articles/lawn-watering-schedule): Frequency and depth guidelines
- [Spring Lawn Care Guide](https://lawncare.center/articles/spring-lawn-care-essential-first-steps): First steps for spring recovery
- [Fall Lawn Maintenance](https://lawncare.center/articles/fall-lawn-maintenance-guide): Complete fall checklist
- [How to Fix Bare Spots](https://lawncare.center/articles/how-to-fix-bare-spots-in-lawn): Patch repair techniques
- [Weed Control Methods](https://lawncare.center/articles/weed-control-methods): Pre and post-emergent strategies
- [Best Time to Dethatch](https://lawncare.center/articles/best-time-to-dethatch-lawn): Timing and technique
- [Preparing Lawn for Winter](https://lawncare.center/articles/preparing-lawn-for-winter): Winterization checklist

## Structured Data

All article pages include:
- Article schema (headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, wordCount)
- FAQPage schema (question/answer pairs)
- BreadcrumbList schema (navigation hierarchy)
- VideoObject schema (for embedded YouTube content)
- ImageObject schema (featured images with alt text)
